ms.name: Morgan Stanley
ms.program: 2026 Early Insights (virtual sophomore program, Nov 2 & Nov 5). First stage of summer analyst recruiting. Also 2027 Sophomore Summer Analyst programs.
ms.eligibility: Sophomores graduating Dec 2028 to Jun 2029. Dec 2028 is inside the window.
ms.avatarNotes: "First-class business in a first-class way." Values: clients first, do the right thing, lead with exceptional ideas, diversity and inclusion, give back. Interviewers want real research on the firm, a clear link from your background to a specific group, how MS differs from peers. Iona ties: Equity Collective partnership, an MS executive director on Iona's board, Iona students in wealth management.

leerink.name: Leerink Partners
leerink.location: New York · Boston · Charlotte · San Francisco
leerink.keyDateLabel: Open since Sept 18; interviews Jan to Mar 2027. Last cycle filled early.
leerink.program: 2028 Summer Analyst Program, sophomore track. Ten weeks, paid, healthcare IB.
leerink.eligibility: Aimed at current sophomores. Requisition lists May 2029 grads, so ask whether Dec 2028 is accepted.
leerink.avatarNotes: Only bank on the list that does nothing but healthcare. Entrepreneurial, fast-growing, hiring MDs from Jefferies, Barclays, Goldman. Interviewers want a credible, evidence-based 'why healthcare' and 'why Leerink'. Expect technicals plus brain teasers. Your EMT work is the most credible 'why healthcare' a sophomore can have.

syf.name: Synchrony
syf.keyDateLabel: Open since Aug 2026, rolling. Interviews Oct 2026 to Feb 2027.
syf.program: Summer 2027 Business Leadership Program (BLP) internships, ~$31/hr for finance, plus the BLP Sophomore Externship (4-day on-site).
syf.eligibility: No class year stated. 3.0 GPA minimum; U.S. work authorization required.
syf.avatarNotes: No. 1 Best Company to Work For (Fortune/GPTW 2026). CEO Brian Doubles: 'Our culture is built on trust.' Pushes AI hard. You live 10 minutes from HQ, and CareCredit (healthcare financing) connects to your ER work.

fcb.name: First Citizens Bank: Healthcare Leveraged Finance
fcb.keyDateLabel: Rolling review, typically Aug to Oct. Apply now.
fcb.program: 2027 Summer Intern: Healthcare Leveraged Finance. Underwriting, models, credit memos, live deals. ~$20-31/hr plus housing stipend.
fcb.eligibility: No class year listed. 3.3+ GPA; finance/accounting/econ preferred.
fcb.avatarNotes: Downside-first credit culture from legacy CIT and SVB teams: cash flow, covenants, protecting capital. MD Mike Coiley: 'My role is to give them the tools and space to succeed.' Healthcare-specific credit seat where ER background is relevant on day one.

graham.name: Graham Capital Management
graham.program: 2027 Graham Capital Summer Internship (CT / NYC). Macro hedge fund, ~$21B AUM.
graham.eligibility: No class year listed. A past Hedge Fund Analyst intern did it after sophomore year.
graham.avatarNotes: Data-driven discretionary and systematic macro. Founder Ken Tropin: 'building a team of the best people has remained key.' Tropin won II's 2026 Lifetime Achievement Award (June 2026). Jens Foehrenbach joined from Man Group as President & Co-CIO. Intense internship: commit your summer.

jpm.name: JPMorgan Chase
jpm.program: 2027 JPMorganChase Fellowship Program: paid 5-week sophomore fellowship. Tracks include CIB Investment Banking.
jpm.eligibility: Sophomores, all majors, 3.2+ GPA preferred. Should move to the Dec 2028 class (confirm when it posts).
jpm.avatarNotes: Big, disciplined, proud. Client service, operational excellence, integrity, winning culture. Favorite line: 'we have to execute to win.' Respects preparation, follow-through, ownership, numbers. Turned off by generic 'passion for finance' emails. J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference every January in SF.

gs.name: Goldman Sachs
gs.keyDateLabel: 2028 Summer Analyst apps expected to open
gs.program: No Summer 2027 sophomore internship in the Americas. Real target: 2028 Summer Analyst program, which recruits current sophomores this winter.
gs.eligibility: Class of 2029 window; Dec 2028 fits. 3.7+ GPA is the practical floor.
gs.avatarNotes: 14 Business Principles, clients first. 'Commercial instinct' is the most prized trait. Acceptance under 1%. Head of HR Jacqueline Arthur: judgment and adaptability are harder to teach than technicals; non-traditional backgrounds are an asset. CEO Solomon values how people apply AI tools.

clearview.name: Clearview Capital
clearview.keyDateLabel: No deadline. Small PE shops hire interns when someone asks at the right moment.
clearview.program: Lower-middle-market PE, founded 1999. Healthcare services is a target sector (Advantage Behavioral Health in portfolio).
clearview.eligibility: No posting. Off-cycle ask: request a summer or part-time analyst role directly.
clearview.avatarNotes: Relationships first, transparency and authenticity. Lean team, so interns do real work: buy-and-build models, add-on screening, diligence. Recent deals: Capitol Services acquired Wolz (Aug 2026), new LJM Group platform (Jul 2026), UpSwell Marketing exit (Apr 2026). Respects local, humble people who've read their deals.

gamco.name: GAMCO Investors (Gabelli Funds)
gamco.keyDateLabel: No published deadline. Reach out before summer seats fill.
gamco.program: Summer internship (equity research / summer analyst), runs every year.
gamco.eligibility: No class year published. Apply through gabelli.com/careers or Handshake.
gamco.avatarNotes: Founder-led by Mario Gabelli (Bronx native, Fordham and Columbia MBA). 'Private Market Value with a Catalyst' method. Long-term, frugal, allergic to hype. Big Iona connection: endowed professorship at LaPenta, Gabelli Center for Teaching & Learning, 'hired and worked with many Iona graduates.' Lead with Iona tie and real stock work.

moneco.name: Moneco Advisors
moneco.keyDateLabel: Posting live on Greenhouse; no deadline listed.
moneco.program: Wealth Management Internship at an independent fiduciary (~$1.9B AUM): Morningstar reports, Investment Committee research, eMoney/Orion case study, CRM work.
moneco.eligibility: 2+ years coursework by summer (sophomores qualify). 3.4+ GPA; writing samples required. Academic credit (unpaid).
moneco.avatarNotes: Values: commitment, collaboration, humility, strategic thinking, community involvement. Mentorship, shadowing, team learning. Respects humble, coachable, client-minded people. SIE prep is directly relevant.
